title: The data of cycle.parked
description: A cycle's history line says it parked. Witness: a work line with parked true. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

cycle.description: The cycle id, <blueprint>-<attempt>, unique within one store.

blueprint.description: The blueprint, the factory API's issue.

ticket.description: The ticket, in the ports' shape. Left out when it is the blueprint.

end.description: The end, one that stops for a person.

step.description: The step it stopped at, the line's progress.step. A runner's word: 1 to 80 characters, no control character.

cap.description: The cap that stopped it. A runner's word: 1 to 80 characters, no control character.

parkReason.description: Why it parked. A runner's word: 1 to 80 characters, no control character.

failureKind.description: The kind of failure. A runner's word: 1 to 80 characters, no control character.

failureCause.description: The failure's cause. A runner's word: 1 to 80 characters, no control character.

provider.description: Whether the failure was the model provider's.

repeat.description: How many times the same park repeated.
